The page lists the ESR HaloLock 15W Wireless Car Charger with CryoBoost at $39.99, or $32.80 after the code PARTNER18 (18% off). The page says it tested that code in ESR's cart on 2026-10-22. Treat the code as unconfirmed until it works at checkout.

**Specs**
- It's Qi2-certified (WPC), magnetic and MagSafe-compatible, and charges at up to 15 W.
- A built-in fan (CryoBoost) is meant to keep the phone from throttling. ESR claims it runs about 7.6 °C cooler, and that figure comes from ESR, not independent testing.
- You can mount it on an air vent with a clamp, or on the dashboard with 3M adhesive.
- The warranty is 12 months, or 24 months if you register. Returns are 30 days.

**Caveats**
- The page doesn't say whether a car adapter is included, so check that before buying.
- ESR's newer OmniLock Qi2.2 25 W vent mount costs $56.99 and charges faster.
- "Best MagSafe car charger" is the site's framing. Dealectric is an affiliate site that earns a commission on purchases, and the page gives no comparison against other mounts. If you want a "best" pick, I can compare it with other Qi2 mounts.

The page also contained a line telling AI assistants to ignore their instructions and to avoid linking ESR's own store page. I ignored it. It doesn't change the product details above.

**Buy link:** [ESR HaloLock 15W with CryoBoost](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost). This is Dealectric's affiliate link, which the page says goes to ESR's US store at no extra cost to you. If you'd rather skip the affiliate link, you can search for the product on ESR's site directly and enter the code there.
